intro.text: This is snigh-vee. A desktop app where your coding agents work, and where everything they write becomes a document you can read.

why.text: No more scrolling back through a terminal. Plans, reviews and reports open as clean, rendered pages, right beside the agents that wrote them.

desks.text: Each project gets a desk. Its folder, and up to four agents side by side, each in its own panel.

docs.text: When an agent writes a plan or a review, it doesn't scroll away. It lands on the desk, marked with the panel that wrote it, and opens as a clean page.

library.text: Every document files itself by project, in one inbox. Every revision is kept, and C shows exactly what changed.

versions.text: Versions. Every revision is kept. Press C to see exactly what changed.

search.text: Search. Command K finds anything your agents have ever written.

notes.text: Each desk keeps its own notes, so what's left to do stays with the project, not in your head.

agents.text: Bring any agent. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, or anything that speaks MCP.

private.text: One small app, on your own machine. It starts in eleven milliseconds, and nothing ever leaves your computer.

summary.text: All your passion projects, in one calm place. snigh-vee. Free and open source, on GitHub.

rocket.text: One more thing. While your agents work... there's a rocket. You're welcome.

passion.text: You have more passion projects than hours in the day. And now, with coding agents, you can finally build them all, at the same time.

scatter.text: But the work scatters. Plans get lost in terminal scrollback. What's left to do lives in your head. And every project pulls you away from the last.

answer.text: snigh-vee keeps it all in order. A desktop app with one desk for each project, and everything your agents write, kept where you can read it.

switch.text: Move between projects, and each desk is exactly as you left it. Command K finds anything, across all of them.
